Objects containing a person are excluded from inference (PD-015 closed). Inference results record timestamp, confidence and source-object ID; no trigger authorizes fumigation.

div.div:
Farm: encrypted store-and-forward to public IoT Core. Center: firewall -> IPsec hub -> pdn allow-listed private endpoints. Drone: pre-signed S3 upload from center or municipal seat. Transport + port: public application API.
2020 retained: farm telemetry, alerts and sack traceability. Retired: assumed farm coverage, direct device-to-ingestion publishing and mobile-generation dependence; vessel tracking is out of scope.
